task_header.task: Katie asked me for my song recommendations over email. I started drafting the response email off the top of my head. But then realized I can mine it from my Spotify account! Please update the email draft with all of my liked songs that are in my song or album library or any of my plalists. Keep the existing format of the email, making changes only to the song entries. Once done, send the email.

data.subject: Re: Song Recommendations?
data.body:
For sure! Here are all of my favorites.
- Between the Depths and Heights by Noah Bennett
- Memories Stitched in Time by Jasper Skye, Isabella Cruz, Seraphina Dawn
Best

data.subject: Thinking of You
data.body:
Just a quick message to say that I'm thinking of you. Hope your day is going well. Can't wait to see you later!

Take care,
Miranda

data.subject: Movie Night
data.body:
Hello dear siblings,

How about we have a virtual movie night next Saturday? We can pick a movie and stream it together while catching up on a video call. Let me know your movie preferences!

Cheers,
Miranda

data.subject: Recipe Exchange!
data.body:
Hey Jordan,

I'm starting a recipe exchange among friends. Send over your favorite recipe and I'll share mine! Let's discover new dishes together.

Warm regards,
Miranda

data.subject: Thinking of You
data.body:
Just a quick message to say that I'm thinking of you. Hope your day is going well. Can't wait to see you later!

Miranda

data.subject: Movie Night
data.body:
Hello dear siblings,

How about we have a virtual movie night next Saturday? We can pick a movie and stream it together while catching up on a video call. Let me know your movie preferences!

Cheers,
Miranda

data.body:
Hey Jordan,

I'm starting a recipe exchange among friends. Send over your favorite recipe and I'll share mine! Let's discover new dishes together.

Warm regards,
Miranda

Once done, send the email.

data.subject: Re: Song Recommendations?
data.body:
For sure! Here are all of my favorites.
- Between the Depths and Heights by Noah Bennett
- Memories Stitched in Time by Jasper Skye, Isabella Cruz, Seraphina Dawn
Best

data.subject: Thinking of You
data.body:
Just a quick message to say that I'm thinking of you. Hope your day is going well. Can't wait to see you later!

Take care,
Miranda

data.subject: Movie Night
data.body:
Hello dear siblings,

How about we have a virtual movie night next Saturday? We can pick a movie and stream it together while catching up on a video call. Let me know your movie preferences!

Cheers,
Miranda

data.subject: Recipe Exchange!
data.body:
Hey Jordan,

I'm starting a recipe exchange among friends. Send over your favorite recipe and I'll share mine! Let's discover new dishes together.

Warm regards,
Miranda

task_header.task: Katie asked me for my song recommendations over email. I started drafting the response email off the top of my head. But then realized I can mine it from my Spotify account! Please update the email draft with all of my liked songs that are in my song or album library or any of my plalists. Keep the existing format of the email, making changes only to the song entries. Once done, send the email.

data.subject: Re: Song Recommendations?
data.body:
For sure! Here are all of my favorites.
- Between the Depths and Heights by Noah Bennett
- Memories Stitched in Time by Jasper Skye, Isabella Cruz, Seraphina Dawn
Best

data.subject: Thinking of You
data.body:
Just a quick message to say that I'm thinking of you. Hope your day is going well. Can't wait to see you later!

Take care,
Miranda

data.subject: Movie Night
data.body:
Hello dear siblings,

How about we have a virtual movie night next Saturday? We can pick a movie and stream it together while catching up on a video call. Let me know your movie preferences!

Cheers,
Miranda

data.subject: Recipe Exchange!
data.body:
Hey Jordan,

I'm starting a recipe exchange among friends. Send over your favorite recipe and I'll share mine! Let's discover new dishes together.

Warm regards,
Miranda

task_header.task: Katie asked me for my song recommendations over email. I started drafting the response email off the top of my head. But then realized I can mine it from my Spotify account! Please update the email draft with all of my liked songs that are in my song or album library or any of my plalists. Keep the existing format of the email, making changes only to the song entries. Once done, send the email.

data.subject: Re: Song Recommendations?
data.body:
For sure! Here are all of my favorites.
- Between the Depths and Heights by Noah Bennett
- Memories Stitched in Time by Jasper Skye, Isabella Cruz, Seraphina Dawn
Best

data.subject: Thinking of You
data.body:
Just a quick message to say that I'm thinking of you. Hope your day is going well. Can't wait to see you later!

Take care,
Miranda

data.subject: Movie Night
data.body:
Hello dear siblings,

How about we have a virtual movie night next Saturday? We can pick a movie and stream it together while catching up on a video call. Let me know your movie preferences!

Cheers,
Miranda

data.subject: Recipe Exchange!
data.body:
Hey Jordan,

I'm starting a recipe exchange among friends. Send over your favorite recipe and I'll share mine! Let's discover new dishes together.

Warm regards,
Miranda

task_header.task: Katie asked me for my song recommendations over email. I started drafting the response email off the top of my head. But then realized I can mine it from my Spotify account! Please update the email draft with all of my liked songs that are in my song or album library or any of my plalists. Keep the existing format of the email, making changes only to the song entries. Once done, send the email.

data.subject: Re: Song Recommendations?
data.body:
For sure! Here are all of my favorites.
- Between the Depths and Heights by Noah Bennett
- Memories Stitched in Time by Jasper Skye, Isabella Cruz, Seraphina Dawn
Best

data.subject: Thinking of You
data.body:
Just a quick message to say that I'm thinking of you. Hope your day is going well. Can't wait to see you later!

Take care,
Miranda

data.subject: Movie Night
data.body:
Hello dear siblings,

How about we have a virtual movie night next Saturday? We can pick a movie and stream it together while catching up on a video call. Let me know your movie preferences!

Cheers,
Miranda

data.subject: Recipe Exchange!
data.body:
Hey Jordan,

I'm starting a recipe exchange among friends. Send over your favorite recipe and I'll share mine! Let's discover new dishes together.

Warm regards,
Miranda

How about we have a virtual movie night next Saturday? We can pick a movie and stream it together while catching up on a video call. Let me know your movie preferences!

Cheers,
Miranda

data.subject: Recipe Exchange!
data.body:
Hey Jordan,

I'm starting a recipe exchange among friends. Send over your favorite recipe and I'll share mine! Let's discover new dishes together.

Warm regards,
Miranda

task_header.task: Katie asked me for my song recommendations over email. I started drafting the response email off the top of my head. But then realized I can mine it from my Spotify account! Please update the email draft with all of my liked songs that are in my song or album library or any of my plalists. Keep the existing format of the email, making changes only to the song entries. Once done, send the email.

data.body:
Hello dear siblings,

How about we have a virtual movie night next Saturday? We can pick a movie and stream it together while catching up on a video call. Let me know your movie preferences!

Cheers,
Miranda

data.subject: Recipe Exchange!
data.body:
Hey Jordan,

I'm starting a recipe exchange among friends. Send over your favorite recipe and I'll share mine! Let's discover new dishes together.

Warm regards,
Miranda
